The ground truth replaces this entirely with the Colebrook equation or Moody chart. While the Moody diagram is mentioned, the erroneous formula is not removed.

While the generated specification references the Moody diagram method (appropriate for turbulent flow) and includes roughness values, it does not explicitly identify Re = 250,000 as turbulent flow and still includes the laminar flow formula f = 64/Re.
